decisions.final_text: Backend engineer with 5 years of Python experience building distributed systems for payments and billing. Strong PostgreSQL fundamentals, hands-on with event-driven architectures, and comfortable owning production services end-to-end including on-call.
- Designed and shipped Python services on the billing team, including idempotent invoice retries that recovered ~$2.4M/yr in transient failures.
- Cut p95 latency on the nightly invoicing batch from 88m to 14m by parallelizing PostgreSQL reads and rewriting the hot loop.
